concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Retain concept broad gently convex low profile, flatter summit shoulders and small shallow depression. No artificial ring terraces or overlarge crater. Whole footprint continuous with irregular low-margin lava surfaces, not stacked intersecting flow plates. Use restrained irregular surface relief and subdued two-tone cooled-flow zones, no radial tiled pattern. Reference photo background Mauna Loa supplies profile only; foreground cinder cones not copied. Concept near-side edge forms are softened rather than mechanical teeth. No copied DEM/photo texture.
